title: JoinTitlePlus
description: Shows a title and subtitle on join.
body:
# JoinTitlePlus

Shows a title when players join.

## Features
- Lightweight and configurable.
- Server-side only.
- Works on Paper/Spigot/Purpur.

## Config (snippet)
```yml
title: "&aWelcome!"
subtitle: "&7Enjoy your stay"
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
